LIVE l 2025 MyK FESTA (DAY1)MyK LIVE KPOP️ l 에스파, 아일릿, 하츠투하츠 등 l 6/19 18:30

Recording Date: 19 June 2025
Broadcasting Date: 27 June 2025

Original Live Streaming Link:
ALL THE K-POP : https://www.youtube.com/live/RLGHrsKPjLw
THE K-POP : https://www.youtube.com/live/Y19dhqDJ2aw

The Live Streaming version is different, it is longer than the SBS broadcast version. The original Live Concert is 3 hours long, but SBS only rebroadcasted it for 45 minutes due to broadcast schedule (A lot of the stage performances were cut)

Such as:
- Hearts2Hearts originally performed 3 songs which are "The Chase + Butterfly + Style", but SBS only broadcasted "Style" performance
- aespa originally performed 5 songs which are "Whiplash + Supernova + Flights, Not Feelings + Thirsty + Next Level", but SBS only broadcasted "Whiplash + Supernova" performance
